description: This Java class 'SearchModelFactory' provides static factory methods for creating and manipulating search-related objects such as SearchResult, SearchFilter, SearchProperty, SearchQuery, and various options used in search queries within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: SearchModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and combine search-related objects such as search results, filters, properties, queries, and options.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult with specified items and next page offset.

methods.name: emptySearchResult
methods.description: Returns an empty SearchResult.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a SearchResult from a JsonObject.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a SearchResult from a JSON string.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for SearchResult.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with an existing SearchResult.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a logical AND filter from multiple SearchFilters.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a logical OR filter from multiple SearchFilters.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a negated SearchFilter.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty from a JsonPointer.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty from a CharSequence path.

methods.name: newSearchQuery
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery from a SearchFilter.

methods.name: newSearchQueryBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for SearchQuery based on a SearchFilter.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption from a list of SortOptionEntries.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption with a single property path and order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOptionEntry with specified property path and order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOptionEntry with specified order and property path.

methods.name: newLimitOption
methods.description: Creates a LimitOption with specified offset and count.

methods.name: newSizeOption
methods.description: Creates a SizeOption with specified size.

methods.name: newCursorOption
methods.description: Creates a CursorOption with specified cursor string.
